title: Multichannel Healthcare Operations: The Impact of Video Visits on the Usage of In-Person Care
authors: Suparerk Lekwijit; Hummy Song; Christian Terwiesch; Krisda H. Chaiyachati
eligible_reason: Single common treatment date and nonlinear estimator. Video visits became available to the treated patient group at the same date (video_visit_avail = treated x period >= 14, i.e. July 2017) versus matched control patients; Tables 3-4 and Figure 2 use xtnbreg (conditional fixed-effects negative binomial, IRRs) with patient and period effects. Table 5 is a cross-sectional logit of follow-up visits. Package ships synthetic data only.
design_notes: Patient-period panel; treated vs matched control (mcontrol) patients; common onset period 14; Figure 2 event study ib13.period#treated in xtnbreg.
data_files_note: README: synthetic datasets that mirror the structure of the original EHR data (HIPAA-protected), much smaller (320 and 286 rows), no real patient information; logs from original data included.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available; screened from package, README, logs and OpenAlex abstract.
